$description: Classic theme content pack. Themes change words only, never visuals. Every key here must exist in every theme (see themes/cs2.json). Placeholders use {curly} names; the renderer fills them. Plain-text strings, sentence case.
name: Classic
voice: Dry, roasting pub-quiz host. Short sentences. Deadpan understatement. Teases the person, never the drinking itself. No health advice, no scolding.

leaderboard.title: The Tab
leaderboard.subtitle: Day {day} of {days}.
leaderboard.maskedNote: Positions are hidden for the last 24 hours. Keep logging; it still counts.
leaderboard.maskedSort: Sorted by name, not by score.

home.firstDrinkHint: Tap a coaster to log your first drink.

toasts.rateAsk: How is it? Rate it now or later in Feed.

predictions.title: Predictions
predictions.subtitle: Locks in {hours} h or at your first drink. Hidden from everyone until the ceremony.
predictions.emptyCardTitle: Call it before your first drink
predictions.emptyCardBody: Five quick guesses about the trip. They lock at your first drink or in {hours} hours, and stay hidden until the ceremony.
predictions.lockedBody: Your five predictions are sealed. Nobody sees them, you included, until the ceremony.
predictions.missedBody: You logged your first drink before predicting. The other {n} still go head to head, and you’re still in every other award.

first_blood.trigger: First drink of the trip (per person)
first_blood.name: First Blood

pit_stop.trigger: Soft drink between two alcoholic drinks
pit_stop.name: Pit Stop

earliest_first.criterion: Earliest first drink of the trip
earliest_first.name: Early Bird

latest_last.criterion: Latest last drink of the trip
latest_last.name: Last One Standing

comeback.criterion: Biggest bounce back after a quiet day
comeback.name: Comeback Kid

night_mvp.criterion: Most litres in a single day (one per day, shown in the replay)
night_mvp.name: Night MVP

metronome.name: The Metronome
metronome.writeup: {perDay} litres a day, give or take a sip, for {days} days straight. You never led the Tab and never left it. Your moon is in a pint glass; your rising sign is last orders.

chaos.name: Chaos Agent
chaos.writeup: Quiet Tuesday, then a shot at 2 a.m. nobody asked for. Your graph looks like a heart monitor at a rave. Nobody could predict you, least of all you.

connoisseur.behaviour: Rates a lot, wine and cocktails, premium drinks
connoisseur.name: The Connoisseur
connoisseur.writeup: {ratings} ratings, a working vocabulary for tannins and a strong opinion on garnish. You didn’t drink the trip; you reviewed it.

explorer.name: The Explorer
explorer.writeup: {unique} different drinks. You never ordered the same thing twice if a menu had a second page. Bartenders will speak of you.

tortoise.name: The Tortoise
tortoise.writeup: Slow start, no finish line. While others burned out by midnight, you were still nursing the same pint, and then another.

speedrunner.name: The Speedrunner
speedrunner.writeup: Three drinks before the menus arrived, asleep before dessert. A glorious sprint, every single night.

designated.name: Designated Hero
designated.writeup: {softShare}% of your drinks were soft. Somebody had to remember where the hotel was. It was you. It was always you.

loyalist.name: The Loyalist
loyalist.writeup: {topDrink}, {topCount} times. The menu was a formality. {topDrink} should be paying you.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.writeup: {afterMidnight}% of your drinks came after midnight. Daylight is a rumour you’ve heard about.

social.behaviour: Most venues and most drinks logged at the same time as others
social.name: Social Butterfly
social.writeup: {venues} venues and {cheers} cheers with the squad. You never drank alone and never stayed anywhere long.

ranks.basis: Std drinks per day of the trip. Bands are placeholders; tune after a test trip.

ready.title: Your Wrapped is ready.
ready.body: Watch yours now. The squad ceremony starts when {owner} hits play.

01_cold_open.note: Half pints counted as halves. We were fair.

02_absurd_units.empty: Zero litres. Zero pints. Zero units of anything. A statement, in its own way.

03_guess_ethanol.question: How much pure alcohol do you think you drank?
03_guess_ethanol.noteLow: Everyone guesses low. You guessed lower.

04_abv_share.share: You drank {share}% of the trip’s alcohol.
04_abv_share.empty: No alcohol, no average, no share. You sat this one out.

06_trail.title: Your trail
06_trail.empty: No pins on the map. You were somewhere. Nobody can say where.

07_top_then_guilty.noGuilty: Your favourite: {topRated}, rated {topRatingValue} every time. No guilty pleasure this trip — suspiciously disciplined.

verdict.loyal: Verdict: loyal. {topShare}% of your drinks were {topDrink}.
verdict.adventurous: Verdict: adventurous. {unique} different drinks and counting.

09_absurd_run.liverMiles: Your ethanol would drive a car {km} km.

10_pace_twin.line: were basically one organism on Day {day}.

11_achievements.title: {n} achievements unlocked
11_achievements.note: Not bad. Not good either. Achievements.

14_archetype.name: {archetype}
14_archetype.noPartner: {archetype}. {perDay} L a day for {days} days, {ratings} ratings, {unique} drinks tried, {softShare}% soft, {topDrink} on repeat ({topCount} times), {afterMidnight}% after midnight, {venues} venues, {cheers} cheers. No drinking partner this trip — you did this one alone, and it shows.

wrappedSquad.title: Squad Wrapped
wrappedSquad.guestSub: Eleven cards. Made to watch together.
wrappedSquad.waitingBody: {owner} starts the ceremony. Get everyone in one room with a screen.
wrappedSquad.ownerSub: You’re the owner. It starts when you say.

02_drunk_o_meter.title: The drunk-o-meter
02_drunk_o_meter.note: Every spike has a story. Some of you remember it.
02_drunk_o_meter.empty: No incidents to report. Nobody drank a drop.

03_keg.note: The landlord would like a word.

04_cities_venues.title: Where it happened
04_cities_venues.empty: No venues logged. You were all somewhere. Nobody knows where.

05_crowd_then_divisive.noCrowd: Not enough ratings for a crowd favourite this time.
05_crowd_then_divisive.noDivisive: Nobody disagreed enough to crown a most divisive drink.

06_replay.title: The replay
06_replay.empty: No drinks, no replay. A quiet one.

08_predictions.title: Predictions
08_predictions.empty: Nobody predicted this time, so there’s no Oracle to crown.

10_main_board.title: The Tab
10_main_board.subtitle: Final standings, last place up. One name left.
10_main_board.remoteTip: Pause here. Ask the room who they think it is.
